m2_criterion.definition: Current complete four-digit bpost assignments and exact Postal cantons Polygon/MultiPolygon features, including documented special-code and leading-zero normalization, must be pinned by edition, effective and retrieval time, schema, CRS, topology, SHA-256 and explicit public redistribution, derivative, API and commercial-use rights. An approved immutable artifact must pass the real BE AGID loader, API and app: normalized search, loading, no-result, multiple, invalid-geometry and API-failure states, bounds fit, translucent fill, clear outline, provenance, clear and re-search. The reviewed internal-use/noncommercial dataset cannot satisfy this gate. WMS pixels, post-office points, addresses, municipalities, administrative or cadastral units, buffers, Voronoi or learned regions and AGID cells never substitute for the Postal cantons vector. House numbers and buildings require separate permitted stable address/building relations. Metadata, shared code and synthetic fixtures alone never establish M2.

markers: Commercial use of the data under any form is strictly forbidden
